title: Video game-based application for fall risk assessment: a proof-of-concept cohort study.
summary: In 152 adults with diabetes, a video-game assessment using sensor-equipped insoles was compared with reported falls and clinical fall-risk tests. The full text reports AUCs of 0.84 seated and 0.91 standing for classifying prior fall history; this is a proof of concept for fall-risk assessment, not prospective prediction of future falls.
